basis: Large single-city police jurisdiction with an exact public 2024 ArcGIS incident service, explicit query endpoint, point geometry, 2020 census-block IDs, and an official 2024 year-end seven-offense table.
notes: High-value reviewed city packet with strong public geography and a usable official annual anchor, but not a live city-share promotion lane under the current repo doctrine. The public feed is row-per-charge, the official anchors are partly victim-based or vehicle-based, and the incident-style candidates that remain semantically plausible still do not clear numerically.
source_name: Detroit Crime Viewer plus RMS Crime Incidents 2024 service plus DPD 2024 year-end stats
